poll.deadlinePassed.zh-Hans: 已到截止时间，请刷新状态

poll.rules.en: Single choice · Public poll · One vote per member. Votes cannot be changed.
poll.rules.zh-Hans: 单选 · 公开投票 · 每位成员只能投一票，提交后不能改票。

poll.stale.en: Your session changed. Reopen this screen to continue.
poll.stale.zh-Hans: 登录或身份已变更，请重新进入。

poll.questionPrompt.en: What would you like the group to decide?

poll.optionLimit.en: 2–10 options, up to 100 UTF-16 characters each.
poll.optionLimit.zh-Hans: 2–10 个选项，每项最多 100 个 UTF-16 字符。

poll.disabled.en: Group polls are not enabled for this deployment. Nothing has been sent.
poll.disabled.zh-Hans: 当前环境尚未启用群投票，未发送任何内容。

poll.awaitResults.en: Poll created. Refresh to load current results before voting.
poll.awaitResults.zh-Hans: 投票已创建，请刷新读取当前结果后再投票。

poll.historical.en: Results are visible under the server’s access rules. Voting and closing require current group membership.
poll.historical.zh-Hans: 可按服务器权限查看结果；投票与结束操作需要当前群成员资格。

poll.confirmCreateTitle.en: Post this poll to the group?

poll.noRevote.en: You cannot withdraw or change this vote.
poll.noRevote.zh-Hans: 提交后无法撤回或修改这一票。

poll.closeWarning.en: Only the poll creator can close it. No more votes will be accepted.
poll.closeWarning.zh-Hans: 仅发起人可结束投票，结束后将不再接受投票。

poll.unknown.en: The outcome is uncertain. Do not submit another vote. Refresh results, or reopen the poll message to check a submitted creation.
poll.unknown.zh-Hans: 操作结果暂不确定，请勿重复投票。请刷新结果，或打开群内投票消息核对创建结果。

poll.failed.en: Could not load the poll. Refresh to try again.
poll.failed.zh-Hans: 投票读取失败，请刷新重试。

poll.rejected.en: The poll or your membership changed. Refresh and review again.
poll.rejected.zh-Hans: 投票或成员资格已变更，请刷新后重新确认。

poll.blocked.en: This action is unavailable. Check your membership or unresolved submission.
poll.blocked.zh-Hans: 当前无法操作，请检查成员资格或尚未确定的提交。

poll.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 服务器已确认本次操作。

poll.cardHint.en: Open to load the current options and results
poll.cardHint.zh-Hans: 打开后读取当前选项与结果

club.chat.explanation.en: Enter your club’s group chat. The server will create the group if needed and check your current membership.
club.chat.explanation.zh-Hans: 进入俱乐部群聊。服务器将核验当前成员资格，并在需要时创建群聊。

club.chat.disabled.en: Club chat entry is not enabled for this deployment. No group has been created.
club.chat.disabled.zh-Hans: 当前环境尚未启用俱乐部群聊入口，未创建群聊。

club.chat.retry.zh-Hans: 重试进入此俱乐部群聊

club.chat.unknown.en: The group may already exist. Retry checks the same club’s group; it does not request a different group.
club.chat.unknown.zh-Hans: 群聊可能已经创建。重试只会核对同一俱乐部群聊。

club.chat.rejected.en: Current club membership is required. Refresh the club before trying again.
club.chat.rejected.zh-Hans: 需要当前俱乐部成员资格，请刷新俱乐部后重试。
